title: LLMs Still Can't Plan; Can LRMs? A Preliminary Evaluation of OpenAI's o1 on PlanBench

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent on decoding for the GPT-4 Turbo column; resolution plan fixes temperature 0)

prompt.user_template:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a block
Unstack a block from on top of another block
Put down a block
Stack a block on top of another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a block if my hand is empty.
I can only pick up a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not picked up.
I can only unstack a block from on top of another block if the block I am unstacking was really on top of the other block.
I can only unstack a block from on top of another block if the block I am unstacking is clear.
Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am holding the block.
I can only put down a block that I am holding.
I can only stack a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being stacked.
I can only stack a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is clear.
Once I put down or stack a block, my hand becomes empty.
Once you stack a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

[STATEMENT]
{initial_conditions}
{goal}

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
prompt.source_location: Appendix D.1 '(Solvable) Blocksworld Instances - Zero-Shot in Natural Language'
prompt.verbatim: full (PDF line wraps re-joined; identical to the repository query text)

placeholders_paper.initial_conditions: the instance's 'As initial conditions I have that, ...' sentence (last [STATEMENT] block of the repository query)
placeholders_paper.goal: the instance's 'My goal is to have that ...' sentence

output.postprocess: lowercase; the resulting plan is written to a file and checked with VAL against the instance PDDL and domain
output.parse_paper: free text; extract action lines matching 'pick up the X block', 'unstack the X block from on top of the Y block', 'put down the X block', 'stack the X block on top of the Y block' (numbering, markdown and explanations ignored) and map them to PDDL (pick-up x), (unstack x y), (put-down x), (stack x y) with the repository's text_to_plan utility

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: fraction of the 600 instances whose extracted plan is validated by VAL as reaching the goal from the initial state
metric.original_location: Table 1, Blocksworld / Zero Shot, column GPT-4 Turbo (241/600)

notes: Identical run to W4403882451 (same 600 instances, same prompt, same 241/600 cell): execute once and compare twice. The one-shot cell (138/600) needs the repository's example instance per query. || [hook 2026-09-07] load_items() reads plan-bench/prompts/blocksworld (500 four/five-block instances) + blocksworld_3 (100 three-block instances) = the paper's 600 three-to-five-block static set and cuts the target [STATEMENT] out of the one-shot query, so the runner renders the Appendix D.1 zero-shot prompt verbatim; parse() mirrors the repository's rule-based text_to_plan_blocksworld (action word + ordered '<colour> block' mentions per line, wrong object count -> line skipped) after stripping markdown emphasis; score() replaces VAL by an exact simulation of the four-operator domain from the natural-language initial state (checked: all 600 ground-truth plans validate, truncated or reversed plans do not). || [triage 2026-09-09] DEVIATION with a reference-cell caveat. Audit against the paper's released replies (llm_planning_analysis/results/{blocksworld,blocksworld_3}/gpt-4-turbo_chat/task_1_plan_generation_zero_shot.json): the released extracted_llm_plan fields are reproduced 600/600 by the PRE-FIX rule-based extractor (no line.replace('*','')), i.e. Table 1's 241/600 silently dropped markdown-bold action lines (83 replies contain '**'); the current repository extractor (this hook's replica) scores the same replies 254/600 = 42.3%, a parenthetical-tolerant extraction 331/600 = 55.2%. Our replies: pre-fix 31.4% (30.2/31.0/33.0), current 35.9% (35.7/35.2/36.8), tolerant 54.8% (54.5/54.8/55.2); the sister run W4403882451 gives 34.9% / 30.8% / 54.3% (gpt-4o judge 54.7%). The model's actual plan validity is therefore unchanged (about 55%); the reported-number gap comes from reply style: the rule-based extractor skips any action line whose parenthetical mentions an extra block (arity check) and 87% of our replies carry such parentheticals vs 65% of the paper's (only 27/600 of our replies are identical to the released ones, so the paper's GPT-4 Turbo replies were not temperature-0 gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 output). Primary number kept = current repository extractor; like-for-like reference on the paper's own replies = 42.3%.
